summary.text: Rhondalyn Randolph is the Democratic candidate for Kentucky House of Representatives District 13 in the November 3, 2026 general election.
In a Ballotpedia survey, she described herself as a pastor and community leader in Owensboro who serves as executive director of the Owensboro Human Relations Committee.

paragraphs.text: Rhondalyn Randolph, in her 2026 Ballotpedia survey, described herself as a native of Madisonville and longtime resident of Owensboro.

She said she is senior pastor of Pleasant Point Baptist Church in Utica, was licensed to preach in 1997 and ordained in 2006, and was the first woman in Western Kentucky licensed to preach and pastor a Baptist church.
She wrote that she secured state historical landmark designation for the church and cemetery in 2013.
Randolph said she was president of the Owensboro NAACP branch from 2014 to 2025 and previously served as vice president of the NAACP Kentucky State Conference.
Among her stated priorities are housing and childcare costs, access to preschool for Kentucky children, full funding and local control of public schools, and public safety.
